description: This file defines a sealed class 'ChartRenderInfo' which inherits from 'ShapeRenderInfo'. The class provides rendering information specifically for charts within the MigraDoc PDF rendering library, including a property 'FormatInfo' that returns chart-specific formatting details.

classes.name: ChartRenderInfo
classes.description: A class that holds rendering information for chart objects, extending the capabilities of shape rendering info within the MigraDoc library.
